title: 第10章 神秘少女第11章 我叫小冉蓝小冉
content_zh:
“嗷……呜……”
一阵阵凶厉的狼嚎声，在不远处的前方响了起来，而且还有着猛烈的气息波动，同时间，也掺和着人类惨叫的声音，肖恩听到，加快脚步走了过去。
阵阵狼啸，响彻天际，震动虚空！
前面一片开阔的山谷中，尘烟滚滚如巨龙一般腾起，遮天蔽日，一队插着一杆斗大“南”字大旗的车队，正在遭受两头三级魔兽银风狼王带着无数魔狼围杀。
其身后无数头凶残魔狼发疯的扑杀着车队，似乎已经升起了冲天的血腥气息。
“我八岁时说的话，今天竟然兑现了。”
走近了一看，肖恩自己不由得讶异，眼中满是震动之色。
他八岁的时候，也正是诱发小伦体内毒素的那一年，为了给小伦寻找几种天绝谷没有的药草，他带着小伦走出山谷，打劫了一支南洲商会的车队。
也正是因为打劫这支车队，肖恩认识了南洲商会的负责人乔红衣。
肖恩的第一个储物袋就是乔红衣送的，这八年来，无论肖恩需要什么，只要肖恩写好放在约定的地方，乔红衣都是送到。
八年无微不至的照顾之情，令到肖恩对乔红衣的感情很深。
乔红衣将肖恩当作弟弟，肖恩同样将乔红衣当作姐姐。
这一次出谷，是肖恩首次进入天地，肖恩最先想到的，便是第一时间找到乔红衣，这也是他们之间的约定。
当然，还有那个比肖恩还小几岁，第一次见面就拉着他的手不放，央求着他一起回去的清纯小女孩。
她叫小慧，肖恩也一直惦记着这位柔弱的小妹妹。
车队领头顶上正是被他打劫过的乔千山，整个车队的人现在已经是伤亡过半，而随着魔狼的疯狂撕咬，伤亡的人数还在急剧的飙升。
地上没有尸体，只有血迹，死了的，都进了狼腹。
“快，大家合力向前冲，别再去那些管货物了。”
乔千山一身是血，手舞大刀，扫出了一阵狂烈的风暴，指挥着车队中的人拼命的冲退。
由银风狼王带领着的无数残暴的烈风魔狼，足以轻易的灭掉几十个加在一起的眼前力量，乔千山能做的，也不过是垂死挣扎而已。

狼群气焰滔天，不断的冲着车队中的人发出了猛烈的撕咬，一种残忍的浪潮，席卷开来。
别说是乔红衣的车队，就算是不认识的，肖恩都会去救。
肖恩扯下了一块布把脸蒙了起来，从背上拔出了铁剑，大喝一声，旋风般的杀入了狼群中，向着乔千山的位置紧靠了过去。
“小兄弟，你怎么还冲进来，能走快离开吧，这份心意乔某领下了，今日不死，他日必定和小兄弟大醉一场。”
见到这种时候还会有人来救，乔千山很感动，但眼前的一切，显然不是这个境界比自己还要低的少年能够化解得了的。
“废什么话，我来了你们就不会死，准备带领车队往外冲，记住不要回头。”
肖恩冷冷的声音传开，语气间没有一丝的感情波动。
此话如同雷鸣，震动人心，所有人都是目瞪口呆的望着这一幕。
“破浪。”
肖恩一声轻喝，身如鬼魅，突破魔狼的层层防御，瞬间的出现在了银风狼王的身前，一道凌厉的剑芒闪起，带起了一抹残红。
而就在鲜血飞溅之时，身体向前急冲，将银风狼王喷射出来的鲜血全部染到了自己的身上。
肖恩又再对着另一头银风狼王冲了过去，以同样的手法，再将它的鲜血染到了自己的身上。
空气似乎是在这一刻而凝结了起来。
content_en:
"Ouch...ow..."
Waves of fierce wolf howls rang out not far away, and there were violent breath fluctuations. At the same time, they were also mixed with the sound of human screams. When Sean heard it, he quickened his pace and walked over.
Waves of wolf howls resounded throughout the sky and shook the void!
In the open valley ahead, dust and smoke billowed like giant dragons, blocking the sky and the sun. A convoy with a big "South" flag was being attacked by two third-level magic beasts, the Silver Wind Wolf King and countless demon wolves.
Behind him, countless ferocious demonic wolves were frantically attacking the convoy, and a bloody aura seemed to be rising into the sky.
"What I said when I was eight years old has come true today."
Taking a closer look, Sean couldn't help but be surprised, his eyes full of shock.
When he was eight years old, it was also the year that he induced toxins in Xiao Lun's body. In order to find some medicinal herbs for Xiao Lun that were not available in Tianjue Valley, he took Xiao Lun out of the valley and robbed a convoy of the Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce.
It was precisely because of robbing this convoy that Sean met Qiao Hongyi, the head of the Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce.
Sean's first storage bag was given by Qiao Hongyi. Over the past eight years, no matter what Sean needed, as long as Sean wrote it down and put it in the agreed place, Qiao Hongyi would deliver it.
Eight years of meticulous care made Xiao En have a deep affection for Qiao Hongyi.
Qiao Hongyi regards Sean as a younger brother, and Sean also regards Qiao Hongyi as a sister.
This time out of the valley was Sean's first time entering the world. The first thing Sean thought of was to find Qiao Hongyi as soon as possible. This was also their agreement.
Of course, there was also the innocent little girl who was a few years younger than Sean, who held his hand the first time they met and begged him to go back together.
Her name is Xiaohui, and Sean has always been thinking about this fragile little sister.
Above the leader of the convoy was Qiao Qianshan, who had been robbed by him. More than half of the entire convoy had been killed or injured, and with the mad wolf biting, the number of casualties was still soaring.
There were no corpses on the ground, only blood stains. The dead ones all went into the belly of the wolf.
"Quick, let's all work together and move forward. Don't worry about the goods anymore."
Qiao Qianshan was covered in blood, wielding a sword and sweeping out a violent storm, commanding the people in the convoy to rush back desperately.
Countless ferocious gale demon wolves led by the Silver Wind Wolf King were enough to easily destroy dozens of them combined in front of them. All Qiao Qianshan could do was to struggle to the death.
The wolves were so arrogant that they kept biting violently at the people in the convoy. A wave of cruelty swept over them.
Not to mention Qiao Hongyi's team, even if he didn't know anyone, Sean would go and rescue him.
Sean pulled off a piece of cloth to cover his face, pulled out the iron sword from his back, shouted loudly, and rushed into the wolf pack like a whirlwind, approaching Qiao Qianshan's position.
"Little brother, why are you rushing in? Leave as soon as you can. Qiao accepts this intention. If you don't die today, you and my little brother will definitely get drunk in the future."
Qiao Qianshan was touched to see that someone would come to rescue him at such a time, but what he saw in front of him was obviously not something that this young man with a lower level than himself could resolve.
"What nonsense are you talking about? You won't die when I'm here. Prepare to lead the convoy to rush out. Remember not to look back."
Sean's cold voice spread, without any emotion in his tone.
These words were like thunder, shocking people's hearts, and everyone stared at this scene in stunned silence.
"Breaking waves."
Sean shouted softly, like a ghost, breaking through the layers of defense of the demon wolf, and instantly appeared in front of the Silver Wind Wolf King. A sharp sword light flashed, bringing with it a touch of residual red.
And just as the blood spattered, his body rushed forward, staining his body with all the blood sprayed by the Silver Wind Wolf King.
Sean rushed towards the other Silver Wind Wolf King again, using the same technique.Then he stained his body with its blood.
The air seemed to condense at this moment.
